best_for: Photographers and designers with a recent graphics card who want to enlarge photos or old images on their own computer without paying per image.

points.title: Free and open source
points.text: The desktop app is AGPL-3.0 licensed, with several AI upscaling models built in and more in the project's custom-models repository.

points.title: You need a Vulkan GPU
points.text: Upscayl runs on a Vulkan-compatible graphics card. The project warns it will not work on most integrated graphics or CPUs, so check its compatibility list before you rely on it.

points.title: Cloud is the paid add-on
points.text: Upscayl Cloud is separate. A free trial gives 10 credits, and the Pro plan is USD 24.99 for 300 credits a month with images up to 256 MP. Prices were read on the date below.

points.title: Cloud credits do not survive cancelling
points.text: If you cancel a Cloud subscription, its credits are lost, and your Cloud history is deleted after a month.

points.title: Windows 10 and macOS 12 or later
points.text: The Windows installer needs Windows 10 or later, is 64-bit and installs for all users. The Mac build is a universal .dmg for macOS 12 or later.

points.title: Linux Flatpak by the developer
points.text: The Flathub package is verified for Upscayl, x64 only. The project also offers AppImage, Snap and AUR builds.

points.title: Downgrades on Windows
points.text: The Windows listing keeps 17 versions. macOS and Linux list only the current release.
